name: Bolaji Ladokun
headline: Security that holds up in practice, not just on paper.
intro: I build and run security programmes end to end: identity and cloud, detection and response, governance and compliance, and the new questions that AI agents raise. I write here about what actually works when policy meets real systems and real people.

focus.title: Security strategy & governance
focus.text: Building an ISMS that people use: risk, policy, ISO 27001 controls and audit readiness without the theatre.

focus.title: Identity & cloud
focus.text: Zero-trust identity, device compliance and posture management across Microsoft and multi-cloud estates.

focus.title: Detection & resilience
focus.text: SIEM, incident response and offensive testing, so you find the gaps before someone else does.

focus.title: AI governance
focus.text: Letting teams use AI agents safely: guardrails, supervision and accountability that keep up with the technology.
